footer.tagline: Semesta Ruang Alam — an open platform to monitor, understand and act for Indonesia's environment.
footer.disclaimer: Data comes from third-party sources and may change. In an emergency call 112.

hero.intro: SERA runs community waste banks and opens up environmental data, so everyone can take part.

bento.label: Today's highlights
bento.imageAlt: Raja Ampat karst islands seen from above

mission.lead: Indonesia's environmental data is scattered across many agencies. SERA brings it together in one place, with sources and update times.
mission.title: We make environmental crises visible, so more people can act.

cta.title: Seen environmental damage near you?
cta.body: Citizen reports help journalists, researchers and government move faster. It takes under 3 minutes.

wasteBank.title: Waste banks: your waste has value, your environment stays clean
wasteBank.body: Every kilogram sorted and deposited means less waste in landfills and rivers, and extra savings for your family.

crisis.intro: Air quality in 14 cities, weather & extreme heat, earthquakes, fire hotspots and long-term trends from official sources — refreshed automatically.

data.title: Today's numbers
data.intro: Every card shows its source and update time. If a source is unreachable we show the last backup snapshot, clearly labelled.

advice.good: Clean air. Safe for outdoor activity.
advice.moderate: Acceptable. Very sensitive people should limit heavy outdoor exertion.
advice.sensitive: Children, older adults and people with asthma should limit time outdoors.
advice.unhealthy: Everyone should cut outdoor activity and wear an N95 mask outside.
advice.veryUnhealthy: Avoid outdoor activity. Keep windows shut and use an air purifier if available.

fire.title: Fire hotspots
fire.subtitle: Satellite detections, last 24 hours
fire.unavailable: Hotspot data is unavailable right now. Check NASA FIRMS or SiPongi directly.
fire.approx: Regions are approximated from island coordinates.

quake.title: Earthquakes
quake.subtitle: BMKG data, updated with every event

weather.title: Weather & heat
weather.subtitle: Current conditions and 7-day forecast per city
weather.forecastAria: Chart of 7-day maximum and minimum temperature and rainfall

trends.title: Indonesia since 2000
trends.intro: Official annual indicators from the World Bank. Percentages show the change from the first year to the latest data.

action.intro: Pick what suits you best, from filing a report to contributing to this platform.

agenda.title: Upcoming environmental days
agenda.intro: Yearly moments to move together with communities in your city.

community.title: Join the SERA community
community.body: Follow updates, help verify reports, or contribute code and translations. SERA is built in the open.

report.intro: Pollution, illegal logging, land burning or wildlife trafficking. Your report goes to our team for verification.

location.title: Be specific
location.body: Name the village/district or paste coordinates from a map.

time.title: When it happened
time.body: Date and time help us match it with satellite data.

safety.title: Stay safe
safety.body: Don't approach dangerous sites. Contact details are optional.

report.emergency: For an ongoing fire or disaster, call 112 first.

placeholders.title: e.g. Liquid waste dumped into the Citarum River
placeholders.description: What did you see? Since when? Who is affected?

hints.email: Only used if the team needs to follow up. Never published.

errors.titleLong: Title can be at most 120 characters.
errors.dateFuture: Date cannot be in the future.
errors.descriptionLong: Description can be at most 2000 characters.
errors.spam: This report could not be sent.
errors.server: Could not send the report. Please try again shortly.

sent.title: Thank you!
sent.body: We received your report and the team will verify it.
sent.mailto: Your email app opened with the report filled in. Press send there to finish.
sent.openMail: Email app didn't open? Click here

about.intro: SERA (Semesta Ruang Alam) is an open-source project that brings public environmental data together so citizens can understand it and act on it.

monitor.title: Monitor
monitor.body: Automatically pull air, fire and earthquake data from official sources.

open.title: Open up
open.body: Every number shows its source and update time. The platform code is open for audit.

act.title: Mobilise
act.body: Turn information into concrete steps: report, take part and speak up.

fetch.title: Fetch
fetch.body: Data comes straight from the public APIs of BMKG, Open-Meteo and NASA FIRMS.

validate.title: Validate
validate.body: Every response is schema-checked. Broken data is never displayed.

fallback.title: Fallback
fallback.body: If a source fails we show the last snapshot with a clear date label.

review.title: Review
review.body: Crisis content is reviewed by editors and shows its last review date.

contact.title: Want to collaborate?
contact.body: Researchers, journalists, communities or developers: we welcome partnerships and feedback.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page may have moved in our redesign.

wasteBank.intro: Sort at home, drop off at the nearest unit and watch your waste get weighed into a balance. SERA's waste bank programme links residents, collectors and the recycling industry.
wasteBank.demoHint: These numbers are placeholders for display and will be replaced with real programme data.
wasteBank.stepsTitle: Five steps from kitchen to savings

sort.title: Sort
sort.body: Separate plastic, paper, metal and glass at home.

clean.title: Clean
clean.body: Rinse and dry so the resale value stays high.

deposit.title: Drop off
deposit.body: Bring it to a waste bank unit during opening hours.

weigh.title: Weigh
weigh.body: Staff weigh and record each type of waste.

save.title: Save
save.body: The balance goes into your savings book and can be withdrawn.

prices.title: Buying price per kilogram
prices.intro: Prices follow the recycling market and may differ per unit.

start.title: Want to start a waste bank in your neighbourhood?
start.body: We help with setting up a committee, bookkeeping and connecting you to collectors. Guidance follows Ministry of Environment Regulation No. 14/2021.
steps: Form a committee with your neighbourhood or community
Prepare a storage space and a scale
Agree on accepted waste types and prices with collectors
Open member registration and savings books
Record deposits regularly and report results to SIPSN
